titleEn: Ways to Make a Fair Array
title: 生成平衡数组的方案数
summary: 删除一个元素后其右侧下标左移，统计新数组偶数下标和等于奇数下标和的删除位置数。
insight: 预先求原数组奇偶下标总和。枚举删除点时，左侧奇偶性不变，右侧奇偶性互换，据此 O(1) 算出删除后的两类和。
pitfalls: 删除点右侧所有元素奇偶性翻转
删除元素本身不进入任一和
单元素数组删除后两和均为零

solutions.title: 奇偶前缀和
solutions.idea: 分别组合删除点左侧原奇偶和与右侧翻转后的和。
steps: 枚举 i，求去掉当前值后的 rightEven、rightOdd
newEven=leftEven+rightOdd，newOdd=leftOdd+rightEven；相等则计数，再把当前值加入左侧

code.java: class Solution { public int waysToMakeFair(int[] nums){int totalEven=0,totalOdd=0;for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++)if(i%2==0)totalEven+=nums[i];else totalOdd+=nums[i];int leftEven=0,leftOdd=0,answer=0;for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++){int rightEven=totalEven-leftEven-(i%2==0?nums[i]:0);int rightOdd=totalOdd-leftOdd-(i%2==1?nums[i]:0);if(leftEven+rightOdd==leftOdd+rightEven)answer++;if(i%2==0)leftEven+=nums[i];else leftOdd+=nums[i];}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun waysToMakeFair(nums:IntArray):Int{var totalEven=0;var totalOdd=0;for(i in nums.indices)if(i%2==0)totalEven+=nums[i] else totalOdd+=nums[i];var leftEven=0;var leftOdd=0;var answer=0;for(i in nums.indices){val rightEven=totalEven-leftEven-if(i%2==0)nums[i] else 0;val rightOdd=totalOdd-leftOdd-if(i%2==1)nums[i] else 0;if(leftEven+rightOdd==leftOdd+rightEven)answer++;if(i%2==0)leftEven+=nums[i] else leftOdd+=nums[i]};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int waysToMakeFair(vector<int>& nums){int totalEven=0,totalOdd=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)nums.size();++i)(i%2?totalOdd:totalEven)+=nums[i];int leftEven=0,leftOdd=0,answer=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)nums.size();++i){int rightEven=totalEven-leftEven-(i%2?0:nums[i]);int rightOdd=totalOdd-leftOdd-(i%2?nums[i]:0);answer+=leftEven+rightOdd==leftOdd+rightEven;(i%2?leftOdd:leftEven)+=nums[i];}return answer;} };
